what: Duplicate the text section five times and stack the copies on five screen-fixed films, each with an SVG dilate filter (dilate .06·.25·.5·.75·1px + blur .06~.33). Each film shows through only where the cursor has left stamps (circles of radius 303·90·48·25·13px, blur 8). The closer to the cursor, the thicker the films that overlap, so letters bleed like ink, and a trail remains (one stamp per 18px, 35 per layer). Links, buttons and dates are hidden in the duplicates so they don’t bleed. While scrolling the films are hidden, and when scrolling stops (scrollend) they are put back in place. On touch screens each layer has one stamp that follows a Lissajous path (horizontal .5±.3sin t · vertical .45±.22cos .7t, per frame t += .008) it rotates on its own

options.scale: Expansion thickness multiplier, default 1 (based on 16px text)
